title: Open a little more: /ɛ/ and /æ/
goal: Practise /ɛ/ and /æ/ and use it in a short, understandable exchange.
cue: For /æ/, open the jaw more than for /ɛ/ and keep the tongue toward the front. Avoid replacing both sounds with the same vowel.
spelling: e in pen and a in pan are useful starting patterns. Practise with the audio rather than spelling alone.

cards.title: Five words to hear and use
sections: furniture that you sleep on. Puck's bedroom is small.
the color of a ripe tomato. Mia looks at a red bag and a blue bag.
the number 10. There are ten cards in the pack.
a food made from flour and baked. There is bread on the plate.
the part of your body above your neck. Her hand hurts, but her head does not.
Listen to each word. Point or act to show its meaning. Say one word, then one short sentence. Ask for help with spelling patterns you have not learned yet.
